title: Policy Orchestrator: region-affinity heuristics & fallback-variant sanitizer
creator: Diane Chen
description:
Refactor the routing policy engine to centralize validation and runtime sanitization for region selection, tier routing semantics, and fallback model-variant matrices. The existing interpreter has grown ad-hoc guards for region affinity and variant fallbacks; this effort introduces a Policy Orchestrator layer that enforces a deterministic DSL schema, validates constraints at config-load time, and provides runtime guards to prevent unsafe fallthroughs (e.g., mismatched quantization variants across tiers, cross-region latency violations).

Goals:
- Provide a strict but extensible JSON/YAML schema for routing rules with first-class constructs for regionAffinity, tierPriority, and fallbackMatrix.
- Ensure backward compatibility with current rule shapes via a staged migration adapter.
- Surface actionable validation errors to Console and API responses (clear messages and remediation hints).
- Add runtime sanitizers that can automatically rewrite dangerous rules (with audit log) to safe defaults when operating in strict mode.
- Add unit/integration tests exercising cross-region cost/latency heuristics and fallback correctness across model variants.

Why now: Recent incidents where variant fallbacks returned CPU-only models to latency-sensitive customers have exposed gaps in validation. Several customers in Dedicated and Private deployments require explicit region affinity controls and predictable fallback behavior for regulatory and latency reasons.
acceptance_criteria: Schema: a machine-readable schema (JSON Schema v7 or equivalent) exists for all routing rule constructs and is published to the config repo.
Migration: legacy rule shapes are supported by a staged adapter that logs deprecation warnings and provides a one-click transform in Console.
Runtime: when strict_safety=true, policy load fails with clear errors for invalid constructs; when strict_safety=false, unsafe rules are auto-sanitized and audit-logged.
Analytics: Console shows per-rule validation status, number of auto-sanitizations, and the last rewrite reason.
Tests: integration test harness runs through tier routing + fallbackMatrix permutations and verifies model-variant compatibility (quantization, architecture) and region-affinity outcomes.
Performance: median policy-compile time at 95th percentile remains < 30ms for rule sets up to 200 entries.
Rollout: Feature flag gated; gradual rollout to 10% of hosts first, with rollback hooks if error-rate delta > 3x baseline.
